summary: Flatter fat beds expose irregular lobules and shallower coronary trunks follow the shell; the great-vessel silhouette and atrial layout are acceptable for this procedural form approximation.

featureReviews.notes: Closed C1 loft and right-biased apex retain the reference silhouette.
Great-vessel silhouette, branch mouths, and anterior pulmonary crossing remain acceptable.
Flatter fat beds expose lobules and lowered coronary trunks follow the shell sufficiently for form acceptance.

notes: This decision accepts form-refinement only. Smooth tissue and repeated fat granules remain major material/surface deficits; posterior geometry is inferred and atria are simplified. No final or clinical fidelity is claimed.
